Express Garage Doors Inc Affiliate Agreement

1. Introduction to the Agreement

This is an Agreement between you, the Affiliate, and Express Garage Doors Inc ("Company"). Please read these terms with care. This Agreement outlines the rules and regulations of the Affiliate Program for Express Garage Doors Inc. By accepting these Terms and Conditions, you agree that you have read and understood them and agree to be legally responsible for each and every term and condition herein.

2. Definitions

- "Affiliate": Individuals or entities that intend to participate in the Affiliate Program and who will legally be bound by the Terms and Conditions herein.
- "Customers": Individuals and legal entities that are the end users of Express Garage Doors Inc's products and services.
- "Affiliate Program": The program operated by Express Garage Doors Inc, wherein Affiliates are enrolled and rewarded in the form of monetary compensation for referring customers.
- "Affiliate Link": The unique link provided to an Affiliate, used to track referrals and commissions.
- "Referral": A potential customer who was led to the Express Garage Doors Inc website using the Affiliate Link.
- "Commission": The monetary compensation earned by an Affiliate from each qualified referral that converts into a sale within 30 days of clicking the Affiliate Link.
- "Abandoned Affiliate Account": Any affiliate account that has not been accessed for a period of 12 months, or has no affiliate referrals during a period of 6 months.

3. Participation Requirements and Partner Obligations

To join the Affiliate Program, you must:
- Be at least 18 years old.
- Agree to these terms and conditions.

During the application process, provide your full name, and any other requested information. We reserve the right to reject applications or re-evaluate participation at any time.

Affiliates are tasked with promoting Express Garage Doors Inc and referring potential customers using the provided Affiliate Link. Use of marketing materials provided by Express Garage Doors Inc is permitted to assist in promotion.

4. Policies and Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must comply with all laws and regulations applicable to their activities, including marketing and email laws. Prohibited activities include:
- Promoting illegal or unethical content.
- Engaging in misleading or deceptive practices.
- Utilizing PPC advertising with Express Garage Doors Inc branded keywords without permission.
- Operating or promoting through coupon or discount websites.

Self-referrals are not permitted, and any attempt to refer oneself or immediate family will result in disqualification from the program.

5. Commissions and Payments

Commissions are earned for sales made within 30 days of the referral through the Affiliate Link. There is no lifetime commission; the commission period is limited to 30 days from the referral date.

All payments are processed through PayPal on a 30-day cycle. Affiliates must ensure their PayPal account information is accurate and up to date.

6. Termination of Affiliate Account

Either party may terminate this agreement with notice. Changes to the Terms and Conditions will be communicated through the Affiliate Dashboard. Disagreement with amendments allows for termination within a given notice period.

Upon termination by the Affiliate, outstanding commissions will be paid out during the next payment cycle, provided they meet the criteria for payment.

7. Limitation of Liability

Express Garage Doors Inc is not liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from this Affiliate Program. The program is provided "as is," with no warranties regarding its operation or the accuracy of tracking and reporting systems.
